# High Traffic at S-TUN-002 Due to Stadium Concert

- **Classification:** expected_event
- **Root cause:** expected_event at `S-TUN-001`
- **Confidence:** high (Directly evidenced by external event timing matching traffic spikes, with maintenance and changes ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-28 19:00 to 2026-09-28 22:30
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-28 18:56
- **Affected:** S-TUN-002, S-TUN-001

## Summary

A concert at Stade Olympique de Rades caused crowd congestion and a significant traffic surge on nearby sites S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002.

Active users, download volume, and PRB utilization increased above baseline on S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002 between 2026-09-28 19:00 and 22:30.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-28 18:56: Concert at Stade Olympique de Rades started. [EVT-004]
- 2026-09-28 19:00: S-TUN-002 active users rose above baseline. [T4]
- 2026-09-28 19:15: Traffic and PRB utilization spiked on S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002. [T1, T4]
- 2026-09-28 19:58: High PRB warning alarm raised on S-TUN-001. [ALM-000633]
- 2026-09-28 20:14: High PRB warning alarm raised on S-TUN-002. [ALM-000634]
- 2026-09-28 22:30: KPIs recovered to baseline levels. [T4]
- 2026-09-28 22:37: Concert at Stade Olympique de Rades ended. [EVT-004]

## Evidence

- S-TUN-002 active users were above baseline from 2026-09-28 19:00 to 22:30. [T4]
- S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002 download volume and PRB utilization spiked above baseline from 2026-09-28 19:15 to 22:30. [T4]
- Concert event EVT-004 occurred near S-TUN-001 from 2026-09-28 18:56 to 22:37. [EVT-004]
- Warning alarms for high PRB utilization were raised on S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002 during the event window. [ALM-000633, ALM-000634, T5]
- No maintenance windows or changes occurred on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, AGG-TUN-01, or their parents during the incident window. [T6, T7]

## Hypotheses

1. **expected_event** at S-TUN-001: confirmed. Traffic surges precisely align with the nearby stadium concert timing, while maintenance and changes were ruled out. [T3, T4, T6, T7]
2. **bad_change** at S-TUN-002: rejected. Change logs confirmed no changes occurred on the affected nodes and parents during the window. [T7]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000640: Occurred on 2026-09-29, outside the traffic surge window and on an unrelated link.
- ALM-000641: Occurred on 2026-09-29, outside the traffic surge window and on an unrelated link.

## Recommended actions

- No action required as the traffic surge was due to an expected external event and successfully cleared.
